title: RAW REVIEW RECORD: complete letter-recency hand writers with already known conditional counterexamples
summary: Constructive sketches, not an open candidate nomination. The three-slot writer emits a slot reference whenever the next source letter is still stored, otherwise its fixed literal sign, then moves that letter to the front. The already retained S-O-S binding contradicts it because the initial literal S is necessarily still stored at its second written occurrence. A one-slot repeat-only variant was deliberately considered afterward and is separately documented; root reports that the fixed G0 inventory already has distinct repeated e and i motifs, contradicting that variant under G0. Neither conditional result establishes native atom identities. Retain the failed sketches without an automatic repair or target test.

design.mechanism: A complete word is encoded sequentially using fixed literal signs and mandatory references to the three most recently used distinct source letters. The list resets to empty at every word. A separately labelled later one-slot variant uses one immediate-repeat sign instead.
design.unit: One source letter per written atomic sign; complete source words retain their written boundaries. The alphabet and reference signs are disjoint and fixed.
design.contrast: Within-word letter memory versus preceding-word prefix copying, independently chosen homophones, two-height joining, folded coordinate streams or optional ligatures.
design.prediction: Three-slot case: no literal sign can recur until it has been evicted after at least three distinct other letters were subsequently used; references require populated slots and cannot begin a word. One-slot case: every immediately repeated atomic sign must be the single repeat sign, which cannot begin a word. The known fixed bindings already violate the respective conditions.
design.scope: Source-free hand procedures and deductive countercase review only. No target data query, image, native atom identification, G2 orientation judgement, Voynich meaning, experiment, source search or historical claim.
design.common_teaching_kit: Use the invented source alphabet A-Z and 26 distinct literal drawings L_A through L_Z. Their names are explanatory labels, not Voynich values. Every source spelling uses this same bijection. No outside-alphabet character is silently normalized, no literal is a null, and reference drawings are distinct from all literals.

three_slot_sketch.additional_signs: Three distinct atomic reference signs REF1, REF2 and REF3.
writer: At word start empty the ordered list of up to three distinct source letters.
If the next source letter x already occupies list position j, emit REFj. Otherwise emit its ordinary literal sign L_x. This choice is mandatory, with no literal alternative for a cached letter.
Remove x from its old list position if present, put x first and retain only the first three distinct entries. Continue with the next source letter.

At word end insert a visible word space and clear the list. Keep the whole word on one physical line; moving it to a new line changes no sign. Paragraph starts and isolated labels use the same empty-list word start.
reader: At word start use an empty list. A literal L_x decodes as x but is legal only when x is not currently stored.
REFj decodes as the letter currently at position j and is illegal when that slot is empty. Apply the identical move-to-front update after either kind of sign.
The shared literal key and list make every legal word uniquely readable. New words require no dictionary, and complete word repetition produces the same written group each time.
three_slot_sketch.invented_example: ABACABA -> L_A L_B REF2 L_C REF2 REF3 REF2. The lists after successive letters are [A], [B,A], [A,B], [C,A,B], [A,C,B], [B,A,C], [A,B,C].
three_slot_sketch.human_cost: A literal alphabet, three short reference drawings and three ordered erasable slots; one source letter is processed at a time. This is mechanically feasible on a small slate but no historical use or overall ink saving is asserted.
three_slot_sketch.known_conditional_counterexample: Under the existing fixed S-O-S atomic binding, the first S must be a literal because the list begins empty. Processing the intervening O cannot evict it from a three-slot list. The last S would therefore have to be a reference rather than the same literal. This contradicts that complete fixed sequence. The argument does not assume an alphabet value for S or O.
three_slot_sketch.decision: Discard this sketch under the existing S-O-S binding. Do not nominate it as an unexecuted open test or choose a new cache size as though predeclared. The binding is conditional, not a newly established native atom identity.

later_one_slot_variant.chronology: This variant was explicitly considered after noticing the three-slot S-O-S contradiction. It is an adaptive new sketch, not a predeclared survivor or an independent confirmation attempt. Root then supplied its already known G0 double-motif countercase; no new target inspection was performed here.
later_one_slot_variant.additional_sign: One distinct atomic repeat sign REP, disjoint from all 26 literals.
writer: At word start the previous-letter memory is empty, so write the first source letter literally.
For each following source letter x, write REP exactly when x equals the immediately preceding decoded letter; otherwise write L_x. Set the previous-letter memory to x.

End the complete word with a visible space and clear the memory. Whole-word line wrapping, paragraph starts, isolated labels and new words use the same rules as the three-slot sketch. No extra letter allography or optional repeat expansion is allowed.
later_one_slot_variant.reader: Read literals through the fixed key and REP as another occurrence of the preceding decoded letter. REP is illegal at word start; a literal identical to the preceding decoded letter is noncanonical and illegal. These rules uniquely recover every legal complete word.
invented_examples: BALLOON -> L_B L_A L_L REP L_O REP L_N
ABABA -> L_A L_B L_A L_B L_A
later_one_slot_variant.deductive_falsifier: If an atomic sign doubles immediately inside a word, it cannot be a literal, since the second literal would require REP. Therefore all immediately doubled sign types must be the same REP. No sign that begins a word may also double immediately inside any word under the same fixed inventory.
later_one_slot_variant.known_conditional_counterexample: Root reports that the fixed G0 decomposition already has distinct doubled e and i motifs. If those two distinct motifs are the written atomic signs of this writer, both would need to be its single REP, which is impossible. This is a G0-bound contradiction, not an assertion that EVA e/i or G0 motifs have been identified as native letter atoms.
later_one_slot_variant.decision: Discard under the stated G0 binding. No multiple-repeat-sign repair, new allography, bigger alphabet, selected occurrence exclusion or further cache variant follows this review.

predecessors_and_retained_limits: IDEA927 copies a capped prefix of the previous complete word; these sketches copy no preceding-word content and allow identical complete words to recur after the mandatory word reset. IDEA928's connector rule, IDEA929's coordinate folding and IDEA930's three-cell spacing are distinct; none is advanced by this record.

IP071 in docs/IDEA_BACKLOG.md:1966 concerns ditto content from a preceding field and lacks an independently bound ditto/full pair. It is a conceptual reference predecessor, not evidence for these within-word alphabetic conventions.

IDEA237's research_registry/proposals/differential_reading_20260914/ASSESSMENT.md distinguishes a reversible construction from an identified message and forbids free antecedents or resets. The sketches specify their complete memory, boundaries and inverse, but do not acquire meaning from that fact.

GDT857's primary rejects an exclusively nonsingleton cyclic-pool model with known whole-group triples. These sketches reset at each word and retain whole-word triples. They do not rescue GDT857 or propose another triple census; their immediate-letter constraints are different.

GDT849's primary retains independent written e-position lengths and contradicts obligatory equal lengths. A generic whole-word harmony/parity-allography alternative was considered but not added as a second proposal; there is no independent new carrier rule here.
GDT608's directed composition and exact-whole residual advantage remain required explanatory facts. A tiny memory can be defined on paper without explaining those observations.

The current route's IDEA929 failure is only under its fixed S-O-S binding. This record neither extends that failure to all native decompositions nor treats unbound decompositions as evidence of an open successful mechanism.
